Definition: a Chivvite, one of the aboriginal tribes of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Hivite = "villagers"; 1) 6th generation of descendants of Canaan, the son of Ham, who were living in northern Canaan near Mount Hermon at the time of the conquest
